marketing_wrapper: Every image is a flat colour backdrop (neon green #01e013, warm grey #e5e2dd, or black) with a large left-aligned caption and a frameless rounded UI crop (~40pt corners, no device bezel) occupying ~60-65% of the frame, plus small legal text. 04 (discount list) is a marketing composition of cards rather than a real screen. Roughly 60% UI on 01-03 and 05-06.

typography.display: Cash Sans (custom), visible in captions at a light-regular weight, large, tight leading; in-app titles ('Money', 'Paycheck') in the same family at semibold
typography.numerals: bold lining figures, look proportional; no monospace visible; tabular unsure
typography.weights: Captions regular/light; balances bold; labels medium; secondary regular grey
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case; tight tracking on large numerals and captions

palette.background: #f0f0f0 (visual; Money tab canvas), #ffffff on detail screens
palette.accent_strategy: Brand-flooded at moments: the amount-entry keypad screen is entirely neon green, and the backdrop alternates green/grey/black. Inside screens the green is limited to progress rings, chart lines and icon chips; primary buttons are black pills.
palette.source: palette.json 01 and 05 (#01e013 40-45%, #ffffff 40%), 02 (#01e013 43% is the in-app keypad screen), 03-04 (#000000 backdrop); grey canvas visual

shape.radius_language: large and pill: cards ~16-20pt, all buttons full pills, range chips pills, circular icon chips
shape.borders_shadows: None; white cards on light grey, hairline dividers inside cards

liquid_glass_visible: no: tab bar on the keypad screen is flat icons on the green flood
density: low-medium; large balances, 1-2 data points per card, ~20pt between cards
layout: Money tab: page title, stacked cards (Cash balance with two black pill buttons and a Paychecks row; Savings with ring illustration; Bitcoin with sparkline), section headers 'Save & invest', 'Explore'. Pay tab: huge amount, full-width custom keypad, Pool/Request tonal pills, black Pay pill.
navigation: 3-icon tab bar (bank, $, clock), icon-only, custom glyphs, current tab in black, others darker green on the green flood
imagery_and_icons: Custom monoline icon set (outline, rounded terminals); small spot illustrations in black line with neon green fill (scissors cutting a card, green convertible, coconut drink); circular icon chips in black or green
signature_visual_move: The pay screen floods the whole display with neon green and sets the amount in black at roughly six times body size above a bare keypad.

direction_fit.why: Owned neon green, custom Cash Sans, authored line illustrations; the loudness sits in the shell (pay screen, backdrops) while account cards stay black-on-white.

notes: MONEY ANATOMY. Balances left-aligned under a medium label, bold, ~2x body in cards ('$1,226.00'), ~3x centred in the savings ring ('$400.00'). Cents same size and weight as dollars; $ full size, no space. Tabular: no evidence either way; figures look proportional, and the third-party 'Cash Sans Mono' claim is not visible in any screen. Amount entry: '$20' in black bold at ~6x body centred on full-green screen, no cents until typed; keypad digits medium weight; Pool and Request as tonal darker-green pills; Pay as a full-width black pill. Positive amounts are black with a spaced plus ('+ $1,650.00', '+ $20.00', '+ 2.12%'), not green; up-change uses a green arrow and green figure ('↑ 1.18% today'). No negative shown. Charts: smooth neon-green spline (~3pt stroke) with no axes, fill or gridlines; range chips 1D/1W/1M/1Y/ALL as grey pills with selected darker; card sparkline jagged green. Savings uses a thick green progress ring around the balance. Transaction detail ('Paycheck') is a receipt-style card: icon chip, title, timestamp, big amount, then 'Transaction details' and 'What you can do' rows with outline icons.
